content.title: Chord Energy to Acquire Williston Basin Assets From XTO Energy
content.summary: CHRD is set to acquire XTO Energy's Williston Basin assets for $550M, boosting production, efficiency and shareholder returns.

content.title: Equinor Gets Go-Ahead for Drilling Two Wildcat Wells in the North Sea
content.summary: EQNR secures permits to drill two North Sea wildcat wells, with operations led by Deepsea Atlantic and COSLInnovator rigs.

content.title: Subsea7 Announces Major Project Under Agreement With Aramco
content.summary: SUBCY lands a major $750M-$1.25B contract with Aramco for offshore pipeline installation and facility upgrades in Saudi Arabia.

content.title: Baker Hughes Wins Key Contract to Support Sakarya Gas Field Phase 3
content.summary: BKR secures a contract for Sakarya gas field Phase 3, supplying subsea and completion systems to boost offshore production.

content.title: Shell Signs Long-Term U.S. LNG Supply Deal With Italian Firm Edison
content.summary: SHEL inks a 15-year deal to supply U.S. LNG to Edison from 2028, strengthening the Italian firm's portfolio and supply-chain flexibility.

content.title: ExxonMobil to Acquire Superior Graphite Assets, Boost EV Ambitions
content.summary: XOM is set to acquire Superior Graphite assets to build a U.S. synthetic graphite supply chain and boost its EV ambitions.

content.title: EQT Inks 20-Year LNG Purchase Agreement to Diversify Its Portfolio
content.summary: EQT secures a 20-year LNG supply deal with Commonwealth LNG, expanding its export portfolio and boosting global market reach.

content.title: Equinor Extends Contract for Two DOF Platform Supply Vessels
content.summary: EQNR extends its charter for two DOF platform supply vessels through 2026, strengthening a long-standing North Sea partnership.
